nonclaims: A checkpoint dispatch embeds an exact validated card but does not invoke, authenticate, isolate, or attest a provider, model, or subagent.
Exact rollout beats prove supplied cardinality, not faithful simulation, useful diversity, or predictive quality.
Provenance-blind judging removes declared generator identity and notes but does not prove semantic anonymity or independence.
Fixed scores and deterministic selection are reproducible authored judgments, not calibrated probabilities, truth, or narrative quality.
A verifier pass is advisory and cannot replace parent assembly, kernel review, commit, or receipt presentation.
Exact checkpoint artifacts remain sensitive host-side files outside the event ledger and receive no bundled encryption or deletion guarantee.
Historical recovery authenticates one already-durable matching change; it does not let a stale uncommitted proposal write against a later head.
A configured chat can begin play, but durable ChatGPT persistence requires a human bridge or connected host.
Revision 0159 does not report a completed comparative experiment showing that retcon planning or multi-agent topology improves fiction.
